sentences.text:
Hridesh Kumar Sangarwal @ H.K. ... vs The State Of West
Bengal And Anr on 8 September, 2025

08.09.2025
 Ct. No. 32
 Sl. No.12
 Sws.M
 Crr 4448 of 2024
 Hridesh Kumar Sangarwal @ H.K. Sangarwal & Ors.
 vs.
 The State of West Bengal and Anr.
 Mr. Kaushik Choudhury
 ...for the petitioners
 1.

This revisional application has been filed with a prayer for quashing of the proceeding in connection with GR Case No. 5849 of 2023 corresponding to Dum Dum Police Station Case No. 365 of 2023 dated 08.07.2023 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code presently pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 5th Court, Barrackpore.

entities.text: Dum Dum Police Station Case No. 365 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners has drawn my attention to the written complaint containing allegation omnibus in nature.
3. I have gone through the written complaint and other documents annexed herewith to the petition.

5. Petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, of this Court and to the private opposite party No. 2 through speed post with A/D and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

6. Let the matter appear in the list two weeks after the ensuing puja vacation, 2025.
7. All parties to act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of the Court.
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
